h1: Speedboat and ferry from Koh Lanta
lead: Speedboats from Koh Lanta to Phi Phi and Phuket, to the islands of Koh Ngai, Koh Mook, Koh Kradan and Koh Lipe, and on to Langkawi. Also to Ao Nang, and in the high season to Krabi, Railay and Koh Yao.

facts.label: Hotel pickup
facts.value: Included on Koh Lanta, time depends on your beach

facts.label: Check-in
facts.value: 30 min before departure, 1 hr 30 min for Langkawi (immigration)

facts.label: Destinations
facts.value: Koh Phi Phi, Phuket, Koh Ngai, Koh Mook, Koh Kradan, Koh Bulon, Koh Lipe, Langkawi, Ao Nang; in high season Krabi, Railay, Koh Yao Noi, Koh Yao Yai

facts.label: Children
facts.value: Child fare from 3 to 9, under 3 free

beforeYouBook.pickup: Boats leave from Sala Dan pier. We book your seat and arrange the hotel pickup on Koh Lanta, at a time that depends on your beach.
beforeYouBook.weather: Times are for the 2026-2027 season and change with the weather and the sea.
beforeYouBook.children: Children from 3 to 9 pay the child fare. Children under 3 travel free.
beforeYouBook.luggage: Personal luggage only. Bikes and bulky items travel for an extra fee when there is room. No animals and no dangerous goods.

faq.a: Yes, on Koh Lanta. The pickup time depends on your beach and we confirm it when you book.
Yes, from Koh Lanta with a change of boat at Koh Lipe. The speedboat leaves at 10:30, and the 16:00 ferry from Koh Lipe arrives in Langkawi at 18:30 Malaysia time.

faq.q: How do I book a seat?
faq.a: Choose speedboat in the form, pick your date and where you go, and send the message on WhatsApp. We reply with the fare.

legacyText.title: Speedboat and Ferry from Koh Lanta | Secret Travel & Tour
intro: Boats leave from Saladan pier. We book your seat and arrange the hotel pickup on Koh Lanta, at a time that depends on your beach.
Tell us your route, your date and how many of you travel, and we reply with the fare.
legacyText.cardDescription: Speedboats from Koh Lanta to Phi Phi, Phuket, the islands and Langkawi.

dayItems.text: Koh Phi Phi at 9:30, then Phuket (Rassada pier) at 10:30.
Koh Ngai 11:10, Koh Mook 11:20, Koh Kradan 11:35, Koh Bulon 12:35 and Koh Lipe 13:30. From Koh Lipe a ferry goes on to Langkawi, arriving at 18:00 on Malaysian time.
Koh Phi Phi at 13:30, then Phuket at 14:30.

Koh Phi Phi at 15:00, then Phuket at 16:00. From December to April a second boat leaves at the same time for Krabi (15:35), Railay (15:50), Koh Yao Noi (16:15), Koh Yao Yai (16:25) and Ao Nang (16:35, last stretch by shared van).
Koh Ngai 15:40, Koh Mook 15:50 and Koh Kradan 16:10.

goodToKnow: Coming back to Koh Lanta: from Phuket at 8:30, 11:00 and 12:30, with a stop at Phi Phi, arriving at 10:00, 12:30 and 14:00. From Koh Kradan at 10:45 or 12:15 (Koh Mook 11:00 or 12:30, Koh Ngai 11:30 or 12:50), arriving at 12:00 or 13:30.
In high season, from Koh Yao Yai at 8:00, Koh Yao Noi 8:10, Railay 8:35, Ao Nang 7:50 and Krabi 8:50, arriving at Koh Lanta at 10:00.
Check in at the pier 30 minutes before departure, and 1h30 before for Langkawi, for the immigration check.

Times are for the 2026-2027 season and change with the weather and the sea. Some departures run all year, others from 15 October to 30 April. Langkawi runs from 1 November to 15 April, and Krabi, Ao Nang, Railay and Koh Yao from 1 December.

décision client du 08.11.2026 : départs de Koh Lanta du 15 octobre au 30 avril (« Some departures run all year » retiré), enfant de 3 à 9 ans, gratuit sous 3 ans (contrats des deux compagnies, audit D § 10 et 11)

brochure publique des heures de prise en charge d'une seconde compagnie de speedboat (audit C § 1.1) : Koh Lipe 10:30 et 12:30, Phi Phi puis Phuket 10:00, 13:00 et 15:30, Ao Nang 09:00 et 13:30. Heures de départ seulement : ni prix, ni arrivée, ni ponton, ni saison sur la brochure, rien d'ajouté (décision client du 09.11.2026 : départs fusionnés par destination, sans nom de compagnie). La saison « from 1 December » ne vaut que pour le bateau de 14:30 vers Ao Nang de la grille complète. Le 10.11.2026 : arrivées, saisons, retours vers Koh Lanta et le départ de 15:30 vers Ao Nang ajoutés d'après la base partenaires (contrat 2026-2027 de la seconde compagnie, sans prix) ; heures de départ identiques à l'horaire public de prise en charge. Ponton d'arrivée non donné : non affiché
base partenaires, fiche de la seconde compagnie de speedboat : bagages personnels seulement, vélos et objets volumineux avec supplément selon la place, ni animaux ni matières dangereuses (10.11.2026)
